message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, what can a reader anticipate from “otherwise will be dangerous,” and what remains unspecified? Does the surrounding passage support your intended increase in tension? Why would closer examination repay its time compared with an informative revision now, and what uncertainty could make revising premature? What textual evidence would settle your choice? Could you briefly identify your finding, remaining uncertainty, and intended next step in English, then carry out the step you choose?
